data.title: Recovery Fraud Contact Pattern — Payments from Recent Fraud Victims to Unfamiliar Recipients
data.description: Detects potential recovery fraud by identifying payments from customers who filed fraud complaints within the preceding 90 days to previously unseen recipient accounts. Recovery fraud operators re-contact prior fraud victims posing as recovery agents, lawyers, or government officials, extracting additional fees for purported fund recovery. This rule correlates complaint records with subsequent outbound payment activity to flag secondary victimization.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Recovery Fraud Contact Pattern")`
`comment("Cross-references fraud complaints with subsequent outbound payments to new recipients")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  transaction_type IN ("WIRE_OUT", "ACH_OUT", "CRYPTO_TRANSFER")
  amount > 500
| join type=inner max=0 customer_id [
  search index=flame_fraud sourcetype=flame:complaints
  | where complaint_date >= relative_time(now(), "-90d")
  | fields customer_id, complaint_date, original_loss_amount, fraud_type
]
| search NOT [
  search index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
    transaction_type IN ("WIRE_OUT", "ACH_OUT", "CRYPTO_TRANSFER")
    transaction_date < complaint_date
  | dedup recipient_account, customer_id
  | fields recipient_account, customer_id
]
| stats count AS payment_count, sum(amount) AS total_amount,
        values(recipient_account) AS recipients
  BY customer_id, fraud_type, original_loss_amount
| where payment_count >= 1
queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Recovery Fraud Contact Pattern
// Cross-references fraud complaints with subsequent outbound payments
transaction_type IN ["WIRE_OUT", "ACH_OUT", "CRYPTO_TRANSFER"]
| amount > 500
| match(file="flame_fraud_complaints_90d.csv", field=customer_id, include=[complaint_date, original_loss_amount, fraud_type])
| groupBy(customer_id, function=[count(as=payment_count), sum(amount, as=total_amount), collect(recipient_account)])
| payment_count >= 1
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Recovery Fraud Contact Pattern
SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    t.transaction_date,
    t.amount,
    t.recipient_account,
    c.complaint_date,
    c.original_loss_amount,
    c.fraud_type AS original_fraud_type
FROM transactions t
JOIN fraud_complaints c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.complaint_date >= DATEADD(day, -90, t.transaction_date)
  AND t.recipient_account NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT recipient_account
    FROM transactions
    WHERE customer_id = t.customer_id
      AND transaction_date < c.complaint_date
  )
  AND t.amount > 500
ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC

references: UNODC, Organized Fraud — Issue Paper (Vienna, 2024) — Chapter II, Consumer Investment Fraud
falsepositives: Legitimate payments to attorneys or recovery services hired by the victim
Victim making normal payments to new vendors unrelated to fraud
